```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(scplotter)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(grid)
  library(qs2)
})

## =========================================================
## Paths
## =========================================================
PROJECT_DIR <- "/path/to/project"
FIG_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "AML1010_1026/plots/figure2")
dir.create(FIG_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

## =========================================================
## Inputs
##   - Seurat objects: AML1010/AML1026_scrna_preprocessing.R
##   - rhPCR mutation lists: extract_mutations_AML1010/AML1026.R
##   - mito AF/coverage matrices: aml1010_mito_tcf12_subclones.Rmd
## =========================================================
obj_1010 <- qs2::qs_read(file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "AML1010/objects/obj_1010_with_BoneMarrowMap_Broad_final.qs2"))
obj_1026 <- qs2::qs_read(file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "AML1026/objects/obj_1026_with_BoneMarrowMap_Broad_final.qs2"))

AML1010_rhPCR <- readRDS(file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "AML1010/objects/AML1010_rhPCRonly_mutation_data_list_inSeurat.rds"))
AML1026_rhPCR <- readRDS(file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "AML1026/objects/AML1026_rhPCRonly_mutation_data_list_inSeurat.rds"))

af_merged  <- readRDS(file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "AML1010/objects/AML1010_mito_af_merged.rds"))
cov_merged <- readRDS(file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "AML1010/objects/AML1010_mito_cov_merged.rds"))
min_pos_depth <- 5   # per-position mito depth to trust a call (same as the mito analysis)

## =========================================================
## Shared cell-type annotation + colors (BoneMarrowMap broad final)
## =========================================================
ANNOT_COL <- "BoneMarrowMap_CellType_Broad_final"

celltype_colors <- c(
  "HSCs"                  = "#d24163",
  "GMPs"                  = "#4d8445",
  "Lymphoid progenitors"  = "#3e2664",
  "Erythroid progenitors" = "darkorange",
  "Erythroid-like cells"  = "#bd7533",
  "Monocytes"             = "#5bb94d",
  "T-cells"               = "#8DA0CB",
  "B-cells"               = "#A6761D",
  "NK cells"              = "#c959ad",
  "Dendritic cells"       = "#a1af47",
  "Plasma cells"          = "brown",
  "Stromal cells"         = "#A6CEE3"
)
```

```{r UMAPs cell types and TCF12 clones}
set.seed(42)  # random plotting order of genotyped cells

geno_colors <- c(
  "not genotyped" = "lightgrey",
  "wildtype"      = "black",
  "mutated"       = "firebrick"
)

# Colors for the two TCF12 clones (colorblind friendly, opposite)
clone_colors <- c(
  "TCF12 mut1"  = "#D55E00",   # vermillion
  "TCF12 mut2"  = "#0072B2",   # blue
  "both"        = "lightgrey",
  "background"  = "lightgrey"
)

# -------------------------------------------------------
# Shared UMAP limits
# -------------------------------------------------------
umap_coords <- as.data.frame(obj_1010@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings)
colnames(umap_coords) <- c("umap_1", "umap_2")
xlim <- range(umap_coords$umap_1) * 1.02
ylim <- range(umap_coords$umap_2) * 1.02

# -------------------------------------------------------
# Shared theme
# -------------------------------------------------------
shared_theme <- list(
  coord_fixed(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim),
  xlab("UMAP 1"),
  ylab("UMAP 2"),
  theme_classic(base_size = 6),
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 6, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 4.5, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey40"),
    axis.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 5),
    axis.text       = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks      = element_blank(),
    axis.line       = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    panel.border    = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin     = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
  )
)

# -------------------------------------------------------
# Plot 1: Cell type UMAP
# -------------------------------------------------------
p_celltype <- DimPlot(
  obj_1010,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by  = ANNOT_COL,
  label     = FALSE,
  raster    = FALSE,
  pt.size   = 0.1
) +
  scale_color_manual(values = celltype_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  ggtitle("Cell types") +
  shared_theme

# -------------------------------------------------------
# Plot 2: Both TCF12 clones combined
# -------------------------------------------------------
all_cells <- colnames(obj_1010)

get_mutated_cells <- function(geno_df, all_cells) {
  geno_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(bc = as.character(bc)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(bc %in% all_cells) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(bc) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      is_mutated = any(mutated == "mutated"),
      .groups    = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is_mutated) %>%
    dplyr::pull(bc)
}

mut1_cells <- get_mutated_cells(AML1010_rhPCR$TCF12,   all_cells)
mut2_cells <- get_mutated_cells(AML1010_rhPCR$TCF12_2, all_cells)
both_cells <- intersect(mut1_cells, mut2_cells)

# Assign clone labels — cells in both get "background" (lightgrey)
clone_status <- rep("background", length(all_cells))
names(clone_status) <- all_cells
clone_status[mut1_cells] <- "TCF12 mut1"
clone_status[mut2_cells] <- "TCF12 mut2"
clone_status[both_cells] <- "both"  # overwrite with grey if in both

umap_clone <- umap_coords
umap_clone$status <- factor(clone_status[rownames(umap_clone)],
                             levels = c("background", "both",
                                        "TCF12 mut1", "TCF12 mut2"))

# Draw background first, then colored clones randomly
bg   <- umap_clone[umap_clone$status %in% c("background", "both"), ]
fg   <- umap_clone[!umap_clone$status %in% c("background", "both"), ]
fg   <- fg[sample(nrow(fg)), ]
umap_clone_ordered <- rbind(bg, fg)

n_mut1 <- length(setdiff(mut1_cells, both_cells))
n_mut2 <- length(setdiff(mut2_cells, both_cells))
n_both <- length(both_cells)

p_clones <- ggplot(umap_clone_ordered,
                   aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, color = status)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clone_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  ggtitle(label = "TCF12 clones") +
  shared_theme

# -------------------------------------------------------
# Plots 3 & 4: Individual TCF12 mutation UMAPs
# -------------------------------------------------------
make_geno_umap <- function(obj, geno_df, title) {

  all_cells <- colnames(obj)

  status <- geno_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(bc = as.character(bc)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(bc %in% all_cells) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(bc) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      status = ifelse(any(mutated == "mutated"), "mutated", "wildtype"),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  cell_status <- rep("not genotyped", length(all_cells))
  names(cell_status) <- all_cells
  cell_status[status$bc] <- status$status

  umap_df <- umap_coords
  umap_df$status <- factor(cell_status[rownames(umap_df)],
                            levels = c("not genotyped", "wildtype", "mutated"))

  not_geno <- umap_df[umap_df$status == "not genotyped", ]
  geno      <- umap_df[umap_df$status != "not genotyped", ]
  geno      <- geno[sample(nrow(geno)), ]
  umap_df   <- rbind(not_geno, geno)

  n_mut <- sum(cell_status == "mutated")
  n_wt  <- sum(cell_status == "wildtype")
  n_ng  <- sum(cell_status == "not genotyped")

  ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, color = status)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.1, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = geno_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    ggtitle(label = title) +
    shared_theme
}

p_tcf12_1 <- make_geno_umap(
  obj     = obj_1010,
  geno_df = AML1010_rhPCR$TCF12,
  title   = "TCF12 mutation 1"
)

p_tcf12_2 <- make_geno_umap(
  obj     = obj_1010,
  geno_df = AML1010_rhPCR$TCF12_2,
  title   = "TCF12 mutation 2"
)

# -------------------------------------------------------
# Assemble 2x2
# -------------------------------------------------------
panel <- (p_celltype | p_clones) /
         (p_tcf12_1  | p_tcf12_2)

ggsave(
  file.path(FIG_DIR, "AML1010_TCF12_2x2_UMAPs.pdf"),
  panel,
  width       = 9,
  height      = 13,
  units       = "cm",
  useDingbats = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  file.path(FIG_DIR, "AML1010_TCF12_2x2_UMAPs.png"),
  panel,
  width  = 9,
  height = 13,
  units  = "cm",
  dpi    = 300,
  bg     = "white"
)

cat("Done. Saved to", FIG_DIR, "\n")
cat("TCF12 mut1 only:", n_mut1, "\n")
cat("TCF12 mut2 only:", n_mut2, "\n")
cat("Both mutations: ", n_both, "\n")
```

```{r genotyped cells, cell-type composition, mutation frequencies}
stopifnot(
  exists("obj_1010"), exists("obj_1026"),
  exists("AML1010_rhPCR"), exists("AML1026_rhPCR")
)

OUTDIR <- file.path(FIG_DIR, "combined_panel_figure")
dir.create(OUTDIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

EXCLUDE_CT <- c("T-cells", "NK cells")

# ============================================================
# SHARED DEFINITIONS
# ============================================================
tp_labels_raw <- list(
  AML1010 = c("AML1010.1" = "Screening", "AML1010.3" = "C1",
               "AML1010.4" = "C4",        "AML1010.5" = "C10"),
  AML1026 = c("AML1026.1" = "Screening", "AML1026.2" = "DEC",
               "AML1026.3" = "C1",        "AML1026.4" = "EOT")
)

tp_labels_barplot <- list(
  AML1010 = c("AML1010.1" = "TP1", "AML1010.3" = "TP2",
               "AML1010.4" = "TP3", "AML1010.5" = "TP4"),
  AML1026 = c("AML1026.1" = "TP1", "AML1026.2" = "TP2",
               "AML1026.3" = "TP3", "AML1026.4" = "TP4")
)

tp_order <- list(
  AML1010 = c("Screening", "C1", "C4", "C10"),
  AML1026 = c("Screening", "DEC", "C1", "EOT")
)

celltype_order <- c(
  "HSCs", "GMPs", "Lymphoid progenitors", "Erythroid-like cells",
  "Erythroid progenitors", "Monocytes", "T-cells", "B-cells",
  "NK cells", "Dendritic cells", "Plasma cells", "Stromal cells"
)

class_colors <- c(
  "Recurrent"     = "#0072B2",
  "Non-recurrent" = "#E69F00",
  "Total"         = "#009E73"
)

recurrent_by_case <- list(
  AML1010 = c("NRAS"),
  AML1026 = c("NRAS", "SF3B1", "SRSF2")
)

# ============================================================
# PART 1 — BARPLOTS
# ============================================================
count_genotyped <- function(rhpcr_list, recurrent_genes, patient_id, tp_label_map) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(rhpcr_list, function(df, gene) {
    mut_class <- if (gene %in% recurrent_genes) "Recurrent" else "Non-recurrent"
    df %>%
      dplyr::select(bc, sample_name) %>%
      dplyr::distinct() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(mutation_class = mut_class)
  }) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(bc, sample_name, mutation_class) %>%
    dplyr::count(sample_name, mutation_class, name = "n_cells") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      patient   = patient_id,
      timepoint = tp_label_map[sample_name]
    )
}

count_genotyped_total <- function(rhpcr_list, patient_id, tp_label_map) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(rhpcr_list, function(df, gene) {
    df %>%
      dplyr::select(bc, sample_name) %>%
      dplyr::distinct()
  }) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(bc, sample_name) %>%
    dplyr::count(sample_name, name = "n_cells") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      patient        = patient_id,
      timepoint      = tp_label_map[sample_name],
      mutation_class = "Total"
    )
}

df_bar_1010     <- count_genotyped(AML1010_rhPCR, recurrent_by_case$AML1010,
                                    "AML1010", tp_labels_barplot$AML1010)
df_bar_1026     <- count_genotyped(AML1026_rhPCR, recurrent_by_case$AML1026,
                                    "AML1026", tp_labels_barplot$AML1026)
df_bar_1010_tot <- count_genotyped_total(AML1010_rhPCR, "AML1010",
                                          tp_labels_barplot$AML1010)
df_bar_1026_tot <- count_genotyped_total(AML1026_rhPCR, "AML1026",
                                          tp_labels_barplot$AML1026)

plot_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  df_bar_1010, df_bar_1026, df_bar_1010_tot, df_bar_1026_tot
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    timepoint      = factor(timepoint, levels = c("TP1", "TP2", "TP3", "TP4")),
    mutation_class = factor(mutation_class,
                             levels = c("Recurrent", "Non-recurrent", "Total"))
  )

make_barplot <- function(pid, is_right_col = FALSE) {
  ggplot(
    plot_df %>% dplyr::filter(patient == pid),
    aes(x = timepoint, y = n_cells, fill = mutation_class)
  ) +
    geom_col(
      position  = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width     = 0.7,
      color     = "black",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors, name = "Mutation class") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name   = if (is_right_col) NULL else "Genotyped cells",
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(name = NULL) +
    ggtitle(pid) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8, hjust = 0.5),
      strip.background  = element_blank(),
      strip.text        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
      legend.position   = "none",
      axis.title.y      = if (is_right_col) element_blank() else element_text(),
      axis.line         = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.ticks        = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(1.5, "mm"),
      plot.margin       = if (is_right_col) margin(2, 2, 1, 0, "mm") else
                                            margin(2, 2, 1, 2, "mm")
    )
}

p_bar_1010 <- make_barplot("AML1010", is_right_col = FALSE)
p_bar_1026 <- make_barplot("AML1026", is_right_col = TRUE)

# ============================================================
# PART 2 — AREA PLOTS
# ============================================================
make_area_plot <- function(seurat_obj, pid, is_right_col = FALSE) {
  md <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  md$timepoint <- unname(tp_labels_raw[[pid]][
    str_extract(rownames(md), paste0("^", pid, "\\.[0-9]+"))
  ])
  md$celltype_renamed <- factor(
    as.character(md[[ANNOT_COL]]),
    levels = celltype_order
  )
  seurat_obj@meta.data <- md
  seurat_obj <- subset(
    seurat_obj,
    cells = rownames(md)[!is.na(md$timepoint)]
  )
  seurat_obj$timepoint <- factor(
    seurat_obj$timepoint,
    levels = tp_order[[pid]]
  )
  Idents(seurat_obj) <- "celltype_renamed"

  colors       <- celltype_colors
  present      <- levels(droplevels(seurat_obj$celltype_renamed))
  missing_cols <- setdiff(present, names(colors))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    extra <- circlize::rand_color(length(missing_cols), luminosity = "bright")
    names(extra) <- missing_cols
    colors <- c(colors, extra)
  }

  CellStatPlot(
    seurat_obj,
    ident        = "celltype_renamed",
    group_by     = "timepoint",
    plot_type    = "area",
    frac         = "group",
    palcolor     = colors,
    x_text_angle = 45,
    ylab         = "Fraction of cells",
    title        = pid
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title      = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x    = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y    = if (is_right_col) element_blank() else element_text(),
      axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x    = element_blank(),
      plot.margin     = if (is_right_col) margin(2, 2, 1, 0, "mm") else
                                          margin(2, 2, 1, 2, "mm")
    )
}

p_area_1010 <- make_area_plot(obj_1010, "AML1010", is_right_col = FALSE)
p_area_1026 <- make_area_plot(obj_1026, "AML1026", is_right_col = TRUE)

# ============================================================
# PART 3 — LINEPLOTS
# ============================================================
allowed_barcodes <- function(seurat_obj) {
  md <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  rownames(md)[!(as.character(md[[ANNOT_COL]]) %in% EXCLUDE_CT)]
}

summarise_mutfreq <- function(nano_list, pid_prefix, keep_barcodes) {
  purrr::imap_dfr(nano_list, function(df, target_name) {
    df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        target  = target_name,
        mutated = as.character(mutated),
        mutated = ifelse(mutated %in% c("mutated", "wildtype"),
                         mutated, NA_character_)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(mutated),
        stringr::str_starts(sample_name, pid_prefix),
        bc %in% keep_barcodes
      ) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(target, sample_name) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        n_genotyped = dplyr::n(),
        n_mutated   = sum(mutated == "mutated"),
        freq        = ifelse(n_genotyped > 0,
                             n_mutated / n_genotyped, NA_real_),
        .groups     = "drop"
      )
  }) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      timepoint = unname(tp_labels_raw[[pid_prefix]][sample_name])
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(timepoint))
}

make_lineplot <- function(df, pid, highlight_targets, label_targets,
                          highlight_colors, drop_targets = character(0),
                          y_limit_max, y_breaks, is_right_col = FALSE) {
  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!target %in% drop_targets) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = tp_order[[pid]]),
      group     = "Stable mutations"
    )
  if (length(highlight_targets) > 0) {
    df <- df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        group = ifelse(target %in% names(highlight_targets),
                       unname(highlight_targets[target]), group)
      )
  }
  col_map <- c("Stable mutations" = "grey70", highlight_colors)
  col_map <- col_map[!duplicated(names(col_map))]

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = timepoint, y = freq, group = target)) +
    geom_line(aes(color  = group), linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(aes(color = group), size = 0.8) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0.1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      breaks = y_breaks,
      limits = c(0, y_limit_max)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = col_map, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x     = NULL,
      y     = if (is_right_col) NULL else "Mutation frequency",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.title.y    = if (is_right_col) element_blank() else element_text(size = 7),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin     = if (is_right_col) margin(1, 2, 2, 0, "mm") else
                                          margin(1, 2, 2, 2, "mm")
    )

  if (length(label_targets) > 0) {
    last_tp <- tail(levels(df$timepoint), 1)
    df_lab  <- df %>%
      dplyr::filter(target %in% label_targets,
                    timepoint == last_tp) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(label = target)
    p <- p +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data               = df_lab,
        aes(label          = label),
        nudge_x            = 0.2,
        direction          = "y",
        hjust              = 0,
        segment.size       = 0.3,
        size               = 2,
        min.segment.length = 0,
        max.overlaps       = Inf
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
  }
  p
}

df_1010 <- summarise_mutfreq(AML1010_rhPCR, "AML1010",
                              allowed_barcodes(obj_1010))
df_1026 <- summarise_mutfreq(AML1026_rhPCR, "AML1026",

  filename = file.path(OUTDIR, "combined_panel_figure_3rows.pdf"),
  plot     = fig_combined,
  width    = 10.5,
  height   = 13,
  units    = "cm",
  device   = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(OUTDIR, "combined_panel_figure_3rows.png"),
  plot     = fig_combined,
  width    = 10.5,
  height   = 13,
  units    = "cm",
  dpi      = 300
)

message("Done. Saved to: ", OUTDIR)
```

```{r DE volcano TCF12_1 vs TCF12_2}
## ============================================================
## Volcano DE: TCF12_1 clone vs TCF12_2 clone
## - Uses Seurat object: obj_1010 (change if needed)
## - Uses nanoRanger list: AML1010_rhPCR (targets like "TCF12", "TCF12_2")
## - Subsets by BoneMarrowMap compartments using:
##     BoneMarrowMap_CellType_Broad_final
##   keeping ONLY:
##     HSCs, GMPs, Lymphoid progenitors, Erythroid progenitors
## - Assigns each cell to:
##     * "TCF12_1" (mutated for TCF12, NOT mutated for TCF12_2)
##     * "TCF12_2" (mutated for TCF12_2, NOT mutated for TCF12)
##   (cells mutated for BOTH are removed; all others dropped from DE)
## - Runs FindMarkers(Wilcoxon), makes volcano plot, saves PDF+PNG+CSV
## - Plot is fixed at 5 cm (w) x 6 cm (h); fonts scaled down to avoid
##   smudging/clipping at that size; legend dropped (see note below)
## ============================================================

stopifnot(exists("obj_1010"), exists("AML1010_rhPCR"))

## -------------------------
## SETTINGS YOU MAY EDIT
## -------------------------
PID <- "AML1010"
obj <- obj_1010
nano_list <- AML1010_rhPCR

stopifnot(ANNOT_COL %in% colnames(obj@meta.data))

relevant_compartments <- c(
  "HSCs",
  "GMPs",
  "Lymphoid progenitors",
  "Erythroid progenitors"
)

out_prefix <- file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0("Volcano_TCF12_1_vs_TCF12_2_", PID, "_BMMapBroadFinal"))

p_cutoff  <- 0.05
fc_cutoff <- 1

genes_to_label <- c(
  "SELL", "APP", "CAVIN1", "HIST3H2A", "LGALS1", "FAM171A1", "OVCH1-AS1", "POU4F1",
  "CDKN2A", "HLA-DQB1", "HLA-DQA1", "HNRNPLL", "USP44", "TUSC1",
  "RNF217", "SPOCK3", "CCDC8", "HLA-DQA2"
)

## -------------------------
## Helpers
## -------------------------

get_bc_status_from_nano <- function(nano_list, target_name, allowed_cells) {
  if (!target_name %in% names(nano_list)) {
    stop(
      "Target '", target_name, "' not found in nano_list. Available targets include e.g.: ",
      paste(head(names(nano_list), 20), collapse = ", "), " ..."
    )
  }

  df <- nano_list[[target_name]]

  req <- c("bc", "mutated")
  if (!all(req %in% colnames(df))) {
    stop(
      "nano_list[['", target_name, "']] must contain columns: ",
      paste(req, collapse = ", "),
      ". Found: ", paste(colnames(df), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(bc, mutated) %>%
    dplyr::filter(bc %in% allowed_cells)

  # Collapse duplicate bc:
  # call mutated if ANY mutated row exists; else wildtype
  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(bc) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      mutated = dplyr::case_when(
        any(mutated == "mutated")  ~ "mutated",
        any(mutated == "wildtype") ~ "wildtype",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  stats <- df$mutated
  names(stats) <- df$bc
  stats
}

save_png_pdf <- function(prefix, plot, width = 5, height = 6, units = "cm", dpi = 600) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(paste0(prefix, ".png"), plot = plot, width = width, height = height, units = units, dpi = dpi)
  ggplot2::ggsave(paste0(prefix, ".pdf"), plot = plot, width = width, height = height, units = units, device = cairo_pdf)
}

## -------------------------
## 1) Subset to BMMap compartments
## -------------------------
md <- obj@meta.data

subset_cells <- rownames(md)[as.character(md[[ANNOT_COL]]) %in% relevant_compartments]
if (length(subset_cells) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No cells matched relevant compartments in ", ANNOT_COL, ": ",
    paste(relevant_compartments, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# IMPORTANT: use subset() directly (S3 method), NOT Seurat::subset()
subset_obj <- subset(obj, cells = subset_cells)

message("BMMap compartment counts in subset:")
print(table(subset_obj@meta.data[[ANNOT_COL]], useNA = "ifany"))

## -------------------------
## 2) Build clone assignment from TCF12 vs TCF12_2
## -------------------------
TCF12_1_target <- "TCF12"
TCF12_2_target <- "TCF12_2"

allowed <- rownames(subset_obj@meta.data)

t1_status <- get_bc_status_from_nano(nano_list, TCF12_1_target, allowed_cells = allowed)
t2_status <- get_bc_status_from_nano(nano_list, TCF12_2_target, allowed_cells = allowed)

subset_obj$TCF12_clone <- NA_character_

mut_t1 <- names(t1_status)[t1_status == "mutated"]
mut_t2 <- names(t2_status)[t2_status == "mutated"]

mut_both <- base::intersect(mut_t1, mut_t2)
mut_t1_only <- base::setdiff(mut_t1, mut_both)
mut_t2_only <- base::setdiff(mut_t2, mut_both)

subset_obj$TCF12_clone[mut_t1_only] <- "TCF12_1"
subset_obj$TCF12_clone[mut_t2_only] <- "TCF12_2"

message("Clone counts (exclusive; both-mutated removed):")
print(table(subset_obj$TCF12_clone, useNA = "ifany"))
message("Removed (mutated for BOTH): ", length(mut_both))

# Keep only assigned clones for DE
subset_obj_de <- subset(subset_obj, subset = !is.na(TCF12_clone))
subset_obj_de$TCF12_clone <- factor(subset_obj_de$TCF12_clone, levels = c("TCF12_1", "TCF12_2"))
Seurat::Idents(subset_obj_de) <- "TCF12_clone"

if (length(unique(Seurat::Idents(subset_obj_de))) < 2) {
  stop("Not enough cells in both clone groups for DE. Check target names and genotyped cells.")
}

## -------------------------
## 3) Differential expression
## -------------------------
markers <- Seurat::FindMarkers(
  subset_obj_de,
  ident.1  = "TCF12_1",
  ident.2  = "TCF12_2",
  test.use = "wilcox"
)

markers$p_val_adj[markers$p_val_adj == 0] <- 1e-300
markers$log10_pval <- -log10(markers$p_val_adj)

markers$Significance <- ifelse(
  markers$p_val_adj < p_cutoff & abs(markers$avg_log2FC) > fc_cutoff,
  "Significant",
  "Not Significant"
)

## -------------------------
## 4) Volcano plot — compact theme for 5 cm (w) x 6 cm (h)
## -------------------------
log_p_cutoff <- -log10(p_cutoff)
colors <- c("Significant" = "firebrick", "Not Significant" = "lightgrey")

ymax <- max(markers$log10_pval, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
y_breaks <- unique(c(0, log_p_cutoff, seq(5, ceiling(ymax/5) * 5, by = 5)))
y_breaks <- y_breaks[y_breaks <= ymax]

lab_df <- markers[rownames(markers) %in% genes_to_label, , drop = FALSE]
lab_df$gene <- rownames(lab_df)

p <- ggplot2::ggplot(markers, ggplot2::aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = log10_pval, color = Significance)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 0.25, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = log_p_cutoff, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-5, 0, 5),
    labels = c("-5", "0", "+5")
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, ymax),
    breaks = y_breaks,
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = lab_df,
    ggplot2::aes(label = gene),
    size = 1.4,                 # ~5pt — practical floor for legible print text
    color = "black",
    segment.size = 0.1,
    segment.alpha = 0.5,
    box.padding = 0.05,
    point.padding = 0.05,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = 40,
    force = 2
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = expression(log[2]~FC),
    y = expression(-log[10]~adj.~italic(p))
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 5) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "none",                                    # see note below code
    axis.title  = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5),
    axis.text   = ggplot2::element_text(size = 4),
    panel.grid  = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.border = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.line   = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.ticks  = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.5, "mm"),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(1, 1, 1, 1, unit = "mm")
  )

save_png_pdf(out_prefix, p, width = 5, height = 6)
utils::write.csv(markers, paste0(out_prefix, "_markers.csv"))

message("Saved volcano + CSV:")
message("  ", out_prefix, ".png")
message("  ", out_prefix, ".pdf")
message("  ", out_prefix, "_markers.csv")
```

```{r TCF12 subclone marker heatmap with mtDNA variants}
## ============================================================
## Heatmap: Differential marker expression in TCF12 subclones
## ============================================================

stopifnot(exists("obj_1010"), exists("AML1010_rhPCR"))
stopifnot("TCF12" %in% names(AML1010_rhPCR), "TCF12_2" %in% names(AML1010_rhPCR))
stopifnot(exists("af_merged"), exists("cov_merged"), exists("min_pos_depth"))

seurat_obj <- obj_1010
t1 <- AML1010_rhPCR$TCF12
t2 <- AML1010_rhPCR$TCF12_2

## -------------------------
## SETTINGS
## -------------------------
prefix <- file.path(
  FIG_DIR,
  "heatmap_TCF12_vs_TCF12_2_mutated_only_diverging_singleLegend_plus3MT_9222_9820_9655_9525_15530"
)

genes_to_plot <- c(
  "SELL", "HIST3H2A", "FAM171A1", "OVCH1-AS1", "POU4F1", "CDKN2A", "SELP", "APP",
  "CAVIN1", "NEFH", "CYYR1", "SCRN1", "RNF217", "FXYD6", "HNRNPLL", "REEP3",
  "ZNF718", "CPLX1"
)

relevant_compartments <- c("HSCs", "Lymphoid progenitors", "GMPs")
CELLTYPE_COL <- ANNOT_COL
ASSAY_TO_USE <- "RNA"
SLOT_TO_USE  <- "data"
CLIP_Z <- 3

mito_variants <- c("9222C>T", "9820G>C", "9655G>C", "9525G>C", "15530T>C")
mito_present_cutoff <- 1  # AF > 1% => mutated

## -------------------------
## Helper: collapse genotype calls per barcode
## -------------------------
collapse_status <- function(df, cells_keep) {
  stopifnot(all(c("bc", "mutated") %in% colnames(df)))
  df %>%
    mutate(bc = as.character(bc), mutated = as.character(mutated)) %>%
    filter(bc %in% cells_keep) %>%
    group_by(bc) %>%
    summarise(
      status = ifelse(any(mutated == "mutated"), "mutated",
                      ifelse(any(mutated == "wildtype"), "wildtype", "unknown")),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

## -------------------------
## 1) Subset compartments
## -------------------------
if (!is.null(relevant_compartments)) {
  stopifnot(CELLTYPE_COL %in% colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data))
  cells_keep_comp <- rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data)[seurat_obj@meta.data[[CELLTYPE_COL]] %in% relevant_compartments]
  seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = cells_keep_comp)
}

cells_in_seurat <- colnames(seurat_obj)

## -------------------------
## 2) Build per-cell mutation status for both loci
## -------------------------
t1_map <- collapse_status(t1, cells_in_seurat)
t2_map <- collapse_status(t2, cells_in_seurat)

seurat_obj$TCF12_1_status <- "unknown"
seurat_obj$TCF12_2_status <- "unknown"
seurat_obj$TCF12_1_status[t1_map$bc] <- t1_map$status
seurat_obj$TCF12_2_status[t2_map$bc] <- t2_map$status

## -------------------------
## 3) Mutually exclusive mutated cells, drop double mutants
## -------------------------
cells_mut_t1   <- rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data)[seurat_obj$TCF12_1_status == "mutated"]
cells_mut_t2   <- rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data)[seurat_obj$TCF12_2_status == "mutated"]
cells_mut_both <- intersect(cells_mut_t1, cells_mut_t2)

cells_tcf12_only   <- setdiff(cells_mut_t1, cells_mut_both)
cells_tcf12_2_only <- setdiff(cells_mut_t2, cells_mut_both)

cat("TCF12 mutated cells:     ", length(cells_mut_t1), "\n")
cat("TCF12_2 mutated cells:   ", length(cells_mut_t2), "\n")
cat("Mutated in BOTH (drop):  ", length(cells_mut_both), "\n")
cat("TCF12-only (keep):       ", length(cells_tcf12_only), "\n")
cat("TCF12_2-only (keep):     ", length(cells_tcf12_2_only), "\n")

cells_keep <- unique(c(cells_tcf12_only, cells_tcf12_2_only))
stopifnot(length(cells_keep) > 0)

seurat_sub <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = cells_keep)
md <- seurat_sub@meta.data

## -------------------------
## 4) Add mtDNA variant statuses to metadata (coverage-aware)
## -------------------------
missing_vars <- setdiff(mito_variants, rownames(af_merged))
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  stop("Missing mtDNA variants from af_merged: ", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "))
}

cells_all     <- colnames(seurat_sub)
cells_in_mito <- intersect(cells_all, colnames(af_merged))

for (v in mito_variants) {
  col_nm <- paste0("MT_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", v), "_status")
  md[[col_nm]] <- "unknown"

  af_vec  <- rep(NA_real_, length(cells_all)); names(af_vec)  <- cells_all
  cov_vec <- rep(NA_real_, length(cells_all)); names(cov_vec) <- cells_all

  af_vec[cells_in_mito]  <- as.numeric(af_merged[v, cells_in_mito])
  cov_vec[cells_in_mito] <- as.numeric(cov_merged[v, cells_in_mito])

  genotyped <- !is.na(cov_vec) & cov_vec >= min_pos_depth

  md[[col_nm]][genotyped & af_vec >  mito_present_cutoff] <- "mutated"
  md[[col_nm]][genotyped & af_vec <= mito_present_cutoff] <- "wildtype"

  cat("\nmtDNA", v, "status (AF>", mito_present_cutoff, "%, coverage-aware):\n")
  print(table(md[[col_nm]], useNA = "ifany"))
}

## -------------------------
## 5) Column ordering: TCF12 blocks (A/B) then TCF12_2 blocks (C/D),
##    random within each block
## -------------------------
blockA <- rownames(md)[md$TCF12_1_status == "mutated" & md$TCF12_2_status == "wildtype"]
blockB <- rownames(md)[md$TCF12_1_status == "mutated" & md$TCF12_2_status == "unknown"]
blockC <- rownames(md)[md$TCF12_2_status == "mutated" & md$TCF12_1_status == "wildtype"]
blockD <- rownames(md)[md$TCF12_2_status == "mutated" & md$TCF12_1_status == "unknown"]

set.seed(42)
blockA <- sample(blockA)
blockB <- sample(blockB)
blockC <- sample(blockC)
blockD <- sample(blockD)

ordered_cells <- unique(c(blockA, blockB, blockC, blockD))
stopifnot(setequal(ordered_cells, colnames(seurat_sub)))

column_split <- factor(
  ifelse(ordered_cells %in% cells_tcf12_only, "TCF12_mutated", "TCF12_2_mutated"),
  levels = c("TCF12_mutated", "TCF12_2_mutated")
)

## -------------------------
## 6) Expression matrix + Z-scaling per gene
## -------------------------
DefaultAssay(seurat_sub) <- ASSAY_TO_USE

genes_present <- intersect(genes_to_plot, rownames(seurat_sub[[ASSAY_TO_USE]]))
if (length(genes_present) == 0) stop("None of genes_to_plot found in RNA assay.")

mat  <- GetAssayData(seurat_sub, assay = ASSAY_TO_USE, layer = SLOT_TO_USE)
expr <- as.matrix(mat[genes_present, ordered_cells, drop = FALSE])

z <- t(scale(t(expr)))
z[is.na(z) | is.infinite(z)] <- 0
z[z >  CLIP_Z] <-  CLIP_Z
z[z < -CLIP_Z] <- -CLIP_Z

## -------------------------
## 7) Colors
## -------------------------
mut_cols <- c("mutated" = "firebrick", "wildtype" = "white", "unknown" = "grey85")

expr_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(-CLIP_Z, 0, CLIP_Z),
  c("#0072B2", "#F7F7F7", "#E69F00")
)

## -------------------------
## 8) Compact top annotation (abbreviated labels, no inline legend)
## -------------------------
top_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  `TCF12`   = md[ordered_cells, "TCF12_1_status"],
  `TCF12_2` = md[ordered_cells, "TCF12_2_status"],
  `9222`    = md[ordered_cells, "MT_9222C_T_status"],
  `9820`    = md[ordered_cells, "MT_9820G_C_status"],
  `9655`    = md[ordered_cells, "MT_9655G_C_status"],
  `9525`    = md[ordered_cells, "MT_9525G_C_status"],
  `15530`   = md[ordered_cells, "MT_15530T_C_status"],
  col = list(
    `TCF12`   = mut_cols, `TCF12_2` = mut_cols,
    `9222`    = mut_cols, `9820`    = mut_cols, `9655`  = mut_cols,
    `9525`    = mut_cols, `15530`   = mut_cols
  ),
  gp = gpar(col = NA),
  show_legend = FALSE,
  annotation_name_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 5, fontface = "italic"),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  border = TRUE,
  simple_anno_size = unit(2, "mm"),
  gap = unit(0.3, "mm")
)

## -------------------------
## 9) Compact heatmap (no title, tiny row name font)
## -------------------------
heatmap_plot <- Heatmap(
  z,
  name = "Expression",
  col = expr_col_fun,
  top_annotation = top_ha,
  column_split = column_split,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 5, fontface = "italic"),
  row_names_side = "left",
  column_title = NULL,
  border = TRUE,
  use_raster = TRUE,
  raster_quality = 5
)

## -------------------------
## 10) Save heatmap body only — 12 cm wide x 5 cm high, no legends
## -------------------------
heatmap_width_in  <- 12 / 2.54
heatmap_height_in <- 5  / 2.54

pdf(paste0(prefix, ".pdf"), width = heatmap_width_in, height = heatmap_height_in, useDingbats = FALSE)
draw(heatmap_plot, show_heatmap_legend = FALSE, show_annotation_legend = FALSE,
     padding = unit(c(1, 16, 1, 1), "mm"))
dev.off()

png(paste0(prefix, ".png"),
    width = heatmap_width_in * 300, height = heatmap_height_in * 300,
    res = 300, type = "cairo-png")
draw(heatmap_plot, show_heatmap_legend = FALSE, show_annotation_legend = FALSE,
     padding = unit(c(1, 16, 1, 1), "mm"))
dev.off()

## -------------------------
## 11) Save legends separately (not counted in the 12x5 cm size)
## -------------------------
heatmap_legend <- Legend(
  col_fun = expr_col_fun,
  title = "Expression (Z)",
  at = c(-CLIP_Z, 0, CLIP_Z),
  direction = "horizontal"
)

annotation_legend <- Legend(
  title = "Mutation status",
  at = c("mutated", "wildtype", "unknown"),
  labels = c("Mutated", "Wildtype", "Unknown"),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = mut_cols[c("mutated", "wildtype", "unknown")])
)

legend_list <- packLegend(heatmap_legend, annotation_legend, direction = "horizontal")

pdf(paste0(prefix, "_legend.pdf"), width = 6, height = 1.5)
draw(legend_list)
dev.off()

message("Saved: ", paste0(prefix, ".pdf"))
message("Saved: ", paste0(prefix, ".png"))
message("Saved: ", paste0(prefix, "_legend.pdf"))
```
